patterns.note: Major content sections reveal with a subtle fade-up animation as they scroll into the viewport, creating a smooth, staggered appearance.
Content is consistently centered within a generous maximum width, providing ample whitespace around text and visual elements.
A very light, warm off-white background (#f8f5ed) is used throughout, providing a soft, consistent canvas that contrasts gently with dark text and vibrant green accents.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are paired with a lighter weight, smaller sans-serif for body text, establishing a clear and airy typographic hierarchy.
Feature sections frequently combine a prominent headline and descriptive text with a detailed, full-width product screenshot or diagram to visually explain the concept.

technique_notes: Implement a scroll-triggered animation system where each major content section slides up slightly and fades in as it enters the user's viewport, creating a smooth reveal effect. The primary navigation bar should be fixed to the top of the screen, maintaining visibility throughout scrolling.
Utilize high-fidelity product screenshots and illustrations within content sections to visually explain features and benefits, often placed centrally or to one side of the descriptive text.
Establish a clear visual hierarchy using large, bold headings for section titles and a more subdued, smaller font for supporting text and descriptions, ensuring readability and scannability.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (H1 ~3x body, H2 ~2x body) with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (4-8px) on buttons, input fields, and card elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and comfortable line spacing for readability.

standout: The site stands out with its exceptionally clean and spacious design, effectively using a muted background to highlight detailed product screenshots and a single vibrant accent color. The emphasis on privacy-focused analytics is reinforced by the clear, no-nonsense presentation, making complex features feel approachable.
